Are you confident in the intersection between technical innovation, sales development and marketing?
Vilomix is a leading international provider of advanced animal nutrition solutions. We are looking for a strong technical profile with good business acumen to drive our pig nutrition product portfolio.
You will become part of a newly established international technical team reporting to the Chief Technical Officer and working closely with highly experienced colleagues. This team plays a key role in driving our international expansion.
At Vilomix, we have deep-rooted expertise in pig nutrition, originating from our leading position in Denmark. Over the past decade, we have rapidly expanded beyond Scandinavia and continue to grow and strengthen our presence in key global markets.
Your responsibilities will include leading and aligning initiatives across the Vilomix Group, co-creating innovative nutritional solutions, and driving the global product strategy for pigs. By harnessing local expertise and capabilities, you will lay a scalable foundation for our long-term commercial success.
Key Responsibilities

  • Lead effective product management to ensure Vilomix offer relevant products and services aligned with our value propositions to target strategic customer segments
  • Collaborate with local product managers, nutritionists and technical support staff to create innovative feed solutions that enhance pig performance, feed efficiency, health and sustainability.
  • Set direction for feed formulation and optimization of the Vilomix premix products.
  • Close collaboration with commercial teams on key accounts and prospects
  • Lead integration of analytical and performance related data tools and software solutions for pig production
  • Analyse and communicate global market trends to align activities with industry developments and customer needs.
  • Provide structured training and coaching for product specialists across the organisation, ensuring expertise in penetrating the pigs market globally.
  • Work closely with procurement and marketing to develop and promote global pig nutrition solutions and activities.
We offer
In Vilomix our foundation is built on collaboration, and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together – across departments, competencies and national borders. Employees are our most important resource, and we make an effort to create the best environment for well-being, development and influence.
Your profile
  • A master or PhD in pigs nutrition, animal Science, veterinary science, or a related field is preferred
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in pigs nutrition, with a focus on premix formulations, feed additives, or animal nutrition.
  • Proven track record in product management and development new product solutions
  • Significant experience in leading teams and managing cross-functional projects
  • Professional proficiency in English
  • Willingness to travel (30%)

Join Vilomix and play a key role in shaping the future of pigs nutrition on a global scale. If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application and CV as soon as possible. We expect to have interviews on an ongoing basis, and we stop the search when the right candidate has been found.
The Vilomix Group
Vilomix is a part of Danish Agro Group. At Vilomix we deliver vitamin- and mineral solutions combined with innovative feed additives to ensure the best results in our customers animal production. All solutions are based on strong animal nutrition know-how. Besides strong premix solutions we also provide high quality concentrates, milk replacers and hygiene products for farmers and feed industry. Our core competences are products and consultancy of particularly high quality to ensure that each individual farm has the best conditions for growth with the help of customer solutions and management support. We want to create value! For agriculture. For the farmer. And for the employees.
At Danish Agro, we are more than 5,500 colleagues in 100+ companies in 17 countries. From the field to the screen, employees are at the heart of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future. They ensure that we can play a crucial role in the industry's digital and green transition – and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. And we need you too!

description:
Na Performa, o Delivery é peça-chave para garantir que nossos projetos sejam executados com excelência, alinhando as expectativas do cliente com a entrega de alto valor. Essa pessoa atua como um facilitador entre os times de desenvolvimento, gestão e stakeholders, garantindo que os objetivos sejam cumpridos dentro do prazo e qualidade esperados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Delivery Manager será responsável por planejar, executar e monitorar projetos de tecnologia, utilizando metodologias ágeis e tradicionais. Monitoramento e Controle:

  • Monitorar o orçamento e cronograma do projeto, realizando ajustes quando necessário.
  • Gerar relatórios de desempenho e apresentar os resultados para stakeholders internos e externos.
Melhoria Contínua:

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Certificação PMP, SAFe ou Scrum Master (desejável).
  • Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de projetos de tecnologia, utilizando metodologias ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos (Jira, MS Project, etc.).
  • Habilidades de liderança, comunicação e negociação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e de forma independente.
  • Orientação para resultados e capacidade de resolução de problemas.
  • Parceria com escolas de Inglês e espanhol
  • ️ Descanso Remunerado

Sobre a empresa

Somos especialistas emTransformação Digital ,trabalhamos como parceiros de nossos clientes, atuando desde a identificação do problema, compreendendo quais suas reais necessidades, até a sustentação da solução desenvolvida.
Atuamos com o desenvolvimento das melhoressoluções em estratégia digital ,engenharia de software ,otimização de processos eexperiência do cliente , priorizando entregas comresultados de curto prazo ediferencial competitivo , apoiando nossos clientes a atingir uma meta, resolver um problema ou satisfazer uma necessidade.
Nossa cultura favorece e promove a colaboração, a agilidade e a criatividade. Vivenciamos e valorizamos a entrega de resultados e não o controle e vigilância excessiva, através da nossa cultura de confiança, propiciamos autonomia a todos os profissionais.

About CloudWalk:

CloudWalk is an AI-first fintech building its own technology to bring justice to the broken payment system in Brazil.

Some people say a company is a unicorn when it reaches a valuation of over 1 billion dollars. We are one of those companies. But we are also a much cooler type of unicorn: a freaking amazing beast that is incredibly rare, cool as hell and damn hard to catch.


The opportunity:

It is desirable:

  • A collaborative spirit, and joy in helping others see, understand, and act on data;
  • Advanced English to thrive in a global, distributed environment.
  • Python (or even better, Python and Ruby) skills to automate analyses, generate insights, and build data products that scale.

Join us at CloudWalk, where we’re not just engineering solutions; we’re building a smarter, AI-driven future for payments—together.

We believe data is not just a resource, it’s a compass. We’re building an AI-powered, data-informed financial future and we want you to help us shape it.

title: Product Manager | Cono Sur Remote in Chile
description:
At EBANX, you’ll help expand access to payments and technology in some of the world’s most dynamic markets. We’re a unicorn-status fintech , AI-powered , and scaling fast across 29 countries and counting .

Our platform connects leading global companies to more than 1 billion consumers , enabling seamless cross-border payments where it matters most. We build with purpose, move with speed, and create solutions that are both innovative and inclusive.

If you’re looking to be part of a company that’s transforming the future of payments with clarity , ambition , and real-world impact — we’d love to meet you.

In the Product team, we’re responsible for creating solutions that deliver real value to our customers and the business. We combine strategic vision, user focus, and cross-team collaboration to build innovative, scalable products aligned with EBANX’s goals.

As aProduct Manager you will be responsible for the strategy, performance, and evolution of EBANX’s local payment solutions in the Cono Sur region. You will act as the owner of the product — defining its vision, driving its adoption, and ensuring its success in the market. This is a high-impact role that combines product strategy, commercial alignment, discovery, and delivery execution.

You'll lead the expansion and optimization of our local payment solutions in Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay, and Bolivia, connecting the dots between merchant needs, business priorities, and market opportunities. You will work at the intersection of strategy and execution, owning the product from discovery to adoption, ensuring EBANX continues to lead in the digital payments landscape.

  • Define the product vision and long-term strategy for payment solutions in the Cono Sur region, aligned with merchant needs and EBANX’s strategic goals;
  • Act as the voice of the product across the organization, connecting local market dynamics with global product direction;
  • Lead product discoveries to deeply understand customer pain points, competitive landscape, and opportunities for innovation;
  • Partner with commercial, operations, finance, marketing, legal and engineering to develop and deliver scalable, compliant and high-impact solutions;
  • Manage the full product lifecycle — from ideation and discovery to go-to-market, enablement, and post-launch iteration;
  • Develop the go-to-market strategy for new features or payment methods, including training, positioning, and performance tracking;
  • Monitor product performance (TPV, revenue, costs, margins) and identify levers for growth, optimization, and differentiation;
  • Build business cases to prioritize initiatives and support strategic decision-making;

Must-haves to shine in this role:

  • Proven experience inproduct management or product strategy , ideally inpayments, fintech, or high-growth tech companies ;
  • Solid understanding of thepayment ecosystem (issuers, acquirers, APMs, schemes, PSPs, settlement, FX, regulations);
  • Strong business acumen — ability to connect product decisions to revenue, cost efficiency, and market impact;
  • Fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese is a plus;
  • Experience working cross-functionally in a global and multicultural environment;
  • Hands-on experience with product discovery, market research, stakeholder alignment, and backlog management;
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to drive consensus and influence across teams;

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience leading local payment strategy in Latin American markets, especially in the Cono Sur region;
  • Deep knowledge of payments ecosystem in LATAM;
  • Ability to translate complexity into clarity — whether in a sales pitch, a product doc, or a roadmap update;
  • Track record of successfully launching and scaling payment solutions;
  • Passion for digital commerce, innovation, and building products that solve real merchant problems;

EBANX offers:

  • Performance Bonus: Annual bonus program based on company results.
  • Meal Allowance: Monthly allowance to support your meals.
  • EBANX Education: Financial assistance for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs to support your professional growth.
  • EBANX Skills: Dedicated budget for courses, certifications, and workshops to encourage continuous learning.
  • Language Classes: Language classes to support your personal and professional development.
  • Health & Well-being: Medical and dental plans with extensive coverage, including support for dependents and wellness programs.
    Flexible Work Culture: Semi-flexible hours, additional day off on your birthday, and year-end break to support work-life balance.
  • Well-being Program: Access to activities and resources that promote physical and mental health.

Follow us on LinkedIn and check out our Instagram to learn more about the #ebanxlife.

A Log,Lab Inteligência Digital é uma empresa com mais de 21 anos de mercado, atuando exclusivamente no setor público, junto à empresas estatais, instituições e órgãos da esfera municipal, estadual e federal. Esta experiência nos confere a possibilidade de agregar muito valor aos contratos nos quais atuamos, por conhecer a fundo as dificuldades e problemas enfrentados pelas instituições públicas no Brasil, e pela troca e compartilhamento do conhecimento adquirido, já que participamos de inúmeros projetos de sucesso por todo o país.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações mobile (frontend em React Native e backend);
  • Traduzir requisitos de sistema em soluções técnicas claras, comunicando-se continuamente com equipes técnicas e stakeholders;
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias Scrum (sprints, refinamentos, plannings e reviews);
  • Integrar sistemas internos e de terceiros, garantindo compatibilidade e segurança;
  • Avaliar, propor e implementar novas tecnologias no ecossistema de desenvolvimento;
  • Aprender e aplicar ferramentas e frameworks emergentes conforme demandas internas.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio de React Native para construção de interfaces responsivas e performáticas;
  • Experiência em backend com PHP, Node.js (ou linguagem similar) e consumo/criação de APIs REST e/ou GraphQL;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) e/ou NoSQL;
  • Prática consolidada com Git (branches, merges, pull requests e code reviews);
  • Experiência prática com Flutter, Kotlin ou Swift;
  • Uso de TypeScript no frontend ou backend;
  • Habilidade em testes automatizados (unitários e de integração);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento (ex.: Sentry, Firebase Crashlytics);
  • Projetos multiplataforma ou experiência prévia com Flutter;
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps: CI/CD, containers e automações de deploy.
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum) e disponibilidade para eventos no fuso GMT-4 (Cuiabá-MT) em modelo remoto.

description:

1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Ubuntu Sales Engineer (Entry-Level) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Ubuntu Pro Sales Engineer to help global companies embrace the latest and greatest Linux and open source applications. Our team applies expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu Pro, OpenStack and Canonical Microcloud, Kubernetes and a wide range of associated technology. The people who love this role are software engineers who enjoy customer conversations and solving customer problems during the presales cycle. Ubuntu is used by pretty much every enterprise in the world, in every industry. This is a fantastic opportunity to learn about the open source technology landscape and develop your business technology insights. You will see first hand in various industries how Linux - and Ubuntu in particular - is shaping innovation and changing the world for the better.
This role is particularly suited to candidates with a technical background who are business minded and driven by commercial success. This role is on our global Field Engineering team and will work closely with enterprise sales leads.
Location: Most of our colleagues work from home. We are growing teams in EMEA, Americas and APAC time zones, so can accommodate candidates from almost any country.
What your day will look like
The Ubuntu Pro Sales Engineer is a key player in our efforts to facilitate and drive the adoption of Ubuntu Pro in the very large Ubuntu enterprise user base.

  • Collect customer business requirements and advise them on Ubuntu and relevant open source applications
  • Identify customer challenges with open source and articulate how Ubuntu Pro could help solve them
  • Deliver presentations and demonstrations of Ubuntu Pro to prospective and current clients
  • Liaise with product teams to give them feedback on requirements to influence roadmap
  • Work collaboratively with your sales team to reach our common targets
  • Global travel up to 25% of time for internal and external events and 25% to customer meetings
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Demonstrated personal interest in continuous learning and development
  • Practical knowledge of Linux, virtualisation, containers and networking
  • Business-minded technology thinker and problem solver
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & leaders, such as Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP
  • Interest in large-scale enterprise open source - private clouds, machine learning and AI, data and analytics
  • Intermediate level Python programming skills
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • A dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to follow up and meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally, for company events up to two weeks long, and customer or industry meetings
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Procurement Project Manager role at Thales

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.
Procurement Project Manager
This position is hybrid model in our São Bernardo do Campo unit.
Position Summary
The Procurement Project Manager (PPM) is responsible to provide efficient and cost-effective value-added purchasing support. Within the Global Business Unit (GBU), the PPM is responsible for supporting procurement activity that are part of a bid, project or product delivery. Within the integrated team, the PPM represents and promotes the Procurement organization. In their role, the PPM provides the best procurement solution (competitiveness, quality, on-time delivery), fulfilling the customer needs and aligned with Thales procurement strategy led by the Global Category Managers (GCM). To this end, and to introduce supplier innovations to our solutions, the PPM plays a key role in the early stages of bids, projects and/or product/service delivery activities. This role is key to a major FAA project and setting up the supply chain and industrial solution with the Category Managers.
Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Develop and maintain the project procurement strategy using input from customer’s tender and prime contract documents, from the project management plan and project schedule from Project Management, project design documentation from Engineering, proposal documents from Marketing, and project financial data from Finance;
  • Challenge the acquisition needs and requirements and to promote design to cost analysis with the suppliers, during the definition phase of the solution, in order to increase the competitiveness of the solution;
  • Create work packages, including all required information to enable an RFQ/RFP (statement of work, delivery schedules, budget, etc.),
  • Assign work packages to relevant Category Manger / Category Buyer
  • Manage the development of the supply chain architecture to meet needs of the project with support from Regional and Global Category Management
  • Optimize supply chain costs early in the life cycle ensuring savings are achieved against budget;
  • Play a key role in defining and implementing strategies to meet U.S. Federal Procurement requirements including offsets, “Buy America” and Small Disadvantaged Business;
  • Work closely with stakeholders including Project Management, Engineering, Marketing and Finance to ensure the procurement strategy is communicated and well understood;
  • Support the flow of information with Project Management through regular reporting on the status of procurement activity - achievements, issues and goals;
  • Monitor project material costs and report deviations against the established project baseline;
  • Play a key role in Make or Buy analysis;
  • Contribute to Post Mortem Analysis (lessons learned) and implement required changes to support the project.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor degree in a relevant field of study;
  • Procurement Management or ISM certifications;
  • Project Management certification;
  • Experience performing similar activities;
  • Track record of success in a similar role in a relevant business or market;
  • Strong communication skills, written and verbal;
  • Excellent organization skills;
  • Project management - planning, time management, problem solving, communication and teamwork;
  • Interpersonal skills - ability to excel working in cross-functional teams;
  • Ability to prioritize tasks while meeting deadlines in a high-pressure environment;
  • Ability to influence in order to deliver business results.

If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!
What We Offer
Thales provides an extensive benefits program for all full-time employees working 30 or more hours per week and their eligible dependents, including the following:
  • Elective Health and Dental plans.
  • Retirement Savings Plan with a company contribution and a match.
  • Company paid holidays, vacation days, and paid sick leave.
  • Company provided Life Insurance.

Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
About Voxy

Voxy, founded in 2010, is a trailblazing language training platform tailored to meet the specific language needs of international organizations. With a mission to enhance productivity, foster collaboration, and unleash human potential, Voxy has established itself as a global leader in the field of corporate language education. With a robust foundation and an ever-evolving vision, Voxy has supported corporate clients across 150 countries by delivering live language coaching led by certified instructors and an expansive library of role-specific courses that bridge critical soft and technical skill gaps.

Today, Voxy's impact spans the globe, with dedicated teams operating across multiple regions, including the United States, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, Thailand, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Originally focused on providing English language instruction, Voxy has evolved to offer an array of languages, including Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, catering to a diverse range of learners.

We believe that learning a language should be fun, rewarding, and a gateway to the best experiences life has to offer. If you agree, we’d love to talk.

You can see more details about our values here ( )

Collaboration and Communication:

FARM | Auxiliar de Serviços de Loja | Rio Petrópolis

Você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com pessoas e entender a história de cada cliente? Aqui na FARM Rio, estamos procurando pessoas que se identificam com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de auxiliar de serviços de loja. Buscamos indivíduos que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, vivendo nossa cultura: ser gente boa , bom de gente e bom de jogo .

Quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por pessoas? Venha para a FARM!

  • Executar rotinas relacionadas à limpeza e organização de toda a loja;
  • Organizar o estoque, tornando o acesso às mercadorias mais eficiente;
  • Realizar a revisão das mercadorias para garantir a qualidade para os clientes;
  • Cuidar da passadoria e reposição de peças no salão de vendas;
  • Gerir de forma eficiente o processo de conferência, recebimento e envio de mercadorias;
  • Participar de inventários;
  • Apoiar o time de vendas no encantamento dos clientes;

Oferecer suporte aos atendimentos realizados em loja e online, colaborando para uma experiência de compra mais positiva. Colaborar para que a loja permaneça atrativa, organizada e encantadora para os clientes, mantendo a ordem também nos provadores.

  • Trabalhar bem em equipe, com espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • Ter facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e na escuta;
  • Ser comprometido com o ambiente de trabalho;
  • Ser uma pessoa dinâmica, flexível, ágil para se adaptar e organizada;
  • Ser proativo e colaborar para que a loja tenha um clima gentil, encantador e eficiente;
  • Ter visão estratégica para entregar resultados e soluções de problemas;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Flexibilidade de horário.

Wellhub (antigo Gympass);

Assistência médica e odontológica com coparticipação;

Zenklub (duas sessões gratuitas por mês para consultas com profissionais de saúde, incluindo psicólogos e nutricionistas);

Política parental estendida: 180 dias para mães e 20 dias para pais;

  • Day off para comemorar seu aniversário;
  • E a melhor parte: descontos em roupas e acessórios da FARM e demais marcas do grupo SOMA.

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

A nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. O que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

Em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. De Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência continuam inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. Seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?
Considerado um dos maiores escritórios de advocacia do Brasil, atuamos de forma abrangente e conceituada, com competência em todas as áreas do Direito. Fundado em 1959, nosso Escritório oferece serviços legais para clientes nacionais e internacionais, dos mais diversos mercados, auxiliando-os no gerenciamento de seus negócios de maneira ética e eficiente. Com escritórios localizados em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Brasília e Porto Alegre, contamos com aproximadamente 200 advogados, prontos para assessorar nossos clientes com o conhecimento e a confiança necessários para lidar com as leis brasileiras, sistemas legais e práticas empresariais singulares. Possuímos vasta experiência em aspectos complexos e pioneiros de transações, tendo desenvolvido competências que ultrapassam fronteiras, sempre mantendo o rigor em relação à qualidade técnica, ética e eficiência. Também somos comprometidos com a Responsabilidade Social Corporativa, por meio dos nossos Comitês de Sustentabilidade, Pro Bono e Diversidade e Inclusão - área na qual somos pioneiros. Fomos reconhecidos com o primeiro lugar na categoria Pequenas e Médias Empresas do Guia Exame Diversidade e recebemos o Selo de Diversidade e Direitos Humanos da Prefeitura de São Paulo. Para essa posição com foco em Fundos de Investimentos, também serão avaliados profissionais de outras localidades, como Rio de Janeiro, Brasília e Porto Alegre.

description:

Job Description – Small Animal Rehabilitation Assistant

Job Location:

Animal Therapy Center

3247 Wimmer Road

Job Spectrum:

This job opening is a non-exempt hourly compensation position with an anticipated weekly commitment of 10-29 hours for part time and 36-38 hours for full time.

Job Summary:

The primary function of therapy assistants is to provide assistance to the CVTs and DVMs on a daily basis during therapy sessions, evaluations and follow up exams. This would include providing customer service to clients and patients, and maintaining a clean facility .

Job Qualifications:

Education:

High school diploma or equivalent

Some college or college equivalent trade school preferred but not required

Experience:

Minimum 1 year animal hospital experience preferred

Reporting Relationship:

You would be expected to report to our medical director and lead therapist.

Job Duties:

General Tasks: Unlock, open, and set up center in the morning and close down at night (responsibility depends upon scheduled shift); check laundry during down time (start loads when dirty laundry bin is full, fold laundry when loads are finished, restock clean towels and sheets in gym, exam rooms, and pool room bin); check clients in or out as needed; answer phones as needed; keep front desk area and bathroom swept and tidy and stocked; wash water dishes; prepare for the day’s appointments

Weekly Tasks: Clean laser goggles, sanitize peanuts/balls/discs, sanitize dandy pads, clean yoga mats, check inventory

Aquatics Room/Eval Room/Locker Room Assistant Tasks: Clean treadmills after each use, keep water clean with pool skimmer as needed during appointments, swap leashes as animals enter or exit, dry animals after treadmill or pool swim, change water dish and sheet in eval room as needed, keep areas swept and tidy, stock as needed (alcohol spray bottle, pool testing materials, soap, paper towels, coffee, etc.), turn on and maintain dehumidifier as needed

Gymnasium/Laser Room/Acupuncture Room Assistant Tasks : Set up and take down therapy equipment as needed for each patient, divide or open the gym as needed, assist doctor or therapist with land therapy as needed (set up course and break down course, walk patients through course, use equipment, give treats, or document therapy session in chart), change water dishes and sheets as needed, keep gymnasium and exam rooms swept and tidy, stock as needed (soap and paper towels at sinks, towels and sheets in laser room, etc.)

Reception Tasks: Ensure all spreadsheets for referral tracking, client data and fill rates are completed monthly. Ensuring and maintaining that all client records are in the computer system, all referral paperwork communicated, and clients are scheduled and charged out properly. Ensuring that all records are set up for the day before and are correct. Maintaining a friendly and compassionate attitude while working the desk and phones. Ensuring that there is someone present at the desk at all times.

Job Requirements:

Can lift up to 50 pounds independently

Ability to stand, bend or sit for 6-8 hours

Ability to climb stairs and assist clients in and out of the building

Ability and willingness to assist clients in getting patients in and out of their cars

Able to handle multiple tasks at once

Motivated individual with a strong desire to learn and develop in this profession

Strong desire to be part of caring and competent team of veterinary professionals

Willing to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends

Must have excellent patient care and client communication skills

Understands the importance of customer service

Working Conditions:

Changes in temperature (heat/cold exposure)

Exposure to zoonotic diseases

Exposure to animals with a possibility of bites/scratches

Exposure to animal’s feces, urine, or other bodily fluids

Exposure to pool chemicals

Exposure to confined spaces and loud noises

Exposure to client’s emotional situations

Exposure to peanut products and latex (ALLERGY WARNING)

The Animal Therapy Center is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of the company to afford equal opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin or age.

description:

#VemSerOC

Pioneiro no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, aOncoclinicas&Co foi fundado em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Na essência daOncoclinicas&Co , o paciente é o centro de tudo. É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.

Aqui na OC valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.

O que você irá fazer

Oferecer uma assistência ativa e personalizada a pacientes em tratamento em qualquer das Unidades do Grupo Oncoclínicas. Para isso, o psicólogo avalia a presença de sintomas emocionais do paciente, identificando potenciais fatores de risco e traçando um plano terapêutico individualizado para cada paciente. Além disso, o profissional estabelece um plano de cuidados psicológicos, avaliando e tratando as condições ligadas ao estado psíquico.

O que você precisa ter

  • Superior completo em Psicologia e registro no CRP;
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação em Psicologia da Saúde ou em Psicologia Hospitalar;
  • Desejável residência em Psico-Oncologia;
  • Necessário vivência com pacientes oncológicos;
  • Pacote Office.

Local e horário de trabalho:

  • CPO Faria Lima/SP
  • Horário: 08h00 às 17h00 de segunda-feira a sexta-feira.

O que oferecemos:

Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos oPROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas

Para contribuir com sua saúde mental, financeira, etc. oferecemos oDR. AON (APOIO AO COLABORADOR – que oferece serviços profissionais de psicólogos, assistentes sociais, advogados e consultores financeiros. Este benefício é sem custos ao funcionário e extensivo aos dependentes

Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos oPLANO DE SAÚDE e oPLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.

É claro que também temos umSEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.

Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos oVALE REFEIÇÃO ou a REFEIÇÃO na empresa e para ajudar nas compras do mês, umVALE ALIMENTAÇÃO .

No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com oDAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.

E para finalizar, nada mais justo do que dividir uma porcentagem do lucro com quem trabalhou por cada realização, não é mesmo? Então, se a Oncoclinicas&Co tem lucro você recebe uma grana a mais em nossoPROGRAMA DE LUCROS E RESULTADOS.

Sobre nosso cliente

A posição terá papel estratégico na interface entre o time financeiro e a área comercial, garantindo que nossas soluções estejam alinhadas às necessidades de nossos clientes e canais, principalmente no que diz respeito a financiamentos via bancos, CPR, barter e outras ferramentas do mercado agro.

* Vivência no relacionamento e negociação com bancos, fintechs, cooperativas de crédito e órgãos de fomento;
* Forte capacidade de análise, visão estratégica, senso de urgência e atuação prática ("mão na massa");
* Habilidade de comunicação, liderança e trabalho em equipe;
* Inglês avançado ou fluente, essencial para interações com a matriz e relatórios internacionais;
* Domínio de ferramentas financeiras, Excel avançado e ERPs (preferencialmente Business Central); conhecimento em ferramentas de BI é um diferencial.

O que está sendo ofertado

* Pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado, incluindo salário fixo, bônus e benefícios;

title: FARM | Vendedor | Santos
description:
Job type: Full-time employee

Você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? Aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de vendas . Buscamos pessoas que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa , bom de gente e bom de jogo .

Quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? Vem pra FARM!

  • Atendimento consultivo à cliente;
  • Ser guardiã da experiência em loja, propagando a cultura da marca;
  • Acompanhar de forma proativa toda a jornada do cliente na loja, desde a entrada até a saída, garantindo uma experiência de compra diferenciada;
  • Foco na fidelização e realização do pós-venda (através da ferramenta Dito), mantendo nossas clientes sempre apaixonadas;
  • Gerenciar suas próprias vendas e entregas, assegurando a eficiência;
  • Impulsionar as vendas digitais, promovendo o código de vendedora e utilizando redes sociais, com foco em criar engajamento e gerar encantamento em cada interação;
  • Manter o ambiente da loja organizado, seguindo os padrões de VM e produção de moda;
  • Realizar o registro das vendas de pagamento digital, através da ferramenta Somabox, garantindo uma experiência de pagamento ágil e segura;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, com um espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • Facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e “escutatória”;
  • Interesse por moda, tendências, boas conversas e paixão pelo que faz;
  • Domínio de ferramentas digitais e redes sociais, essenciais para uma marca que conecta o físico e o digital;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Flexibilidade de horário.

Quem faz parte do time comercial FARM tem direito à:

  • Para garantir o seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:

Wellhub (antigo Gympass);

Assistência médica e odontológica com coparticipação;

Zenklub (duas sessões gratuitas por mês para consultas com profissionais de saúde, incluindo psicólogos e nutricionistas);

Política parental estendida: 180 dias para mães, 20 dias para pais

  • Day off, para curtir o seu aniversário;
  • E a melhor parte: descontos em roupas e acessórios da FARM e demais marcas do grupo SOMA.

Nosso percurso

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo. A nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. O que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

Em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. De Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. E seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

The Senior Sales Engineer role at Infinite Lambda is designed for a technical leader who bridges sales and engineering, driving growth in a fast-growing consultancy focused on data and AI solutions. LOCATION & WORK ARRANGEMENT
The role is remote, but you will be expected to travel to client sites and occasionally for in-person Infinite Lambda meetings. You will be covering both South America and the US, offering flexibility to work remotely and onsite as needed.

PROSPECTIVE CLIENT ENGAGEMENT

  • Conduct and facilitate technical deep-dive workshops with prospective clients to showcase capabilities and gather insights, using workshop outputs to strengthen proposals;

LEAD SALES ENGINEER STRATEGY
  • Work with departments such as Product & Services, Customer Success, and Sales & Partnerships to clearly define roles and responsibilities, ensuring seamless collaboration across functions;
  • Collaborate with Product & Services to stay informed about existing offerings and influence product roadmaps, helping design new products and services based on client feedback and market trends;
  • Enhance the positioning of Infinite Lambda’s products and services during the sales process and beyond, improving how value is communicated to clients;
  • Liaise with senior leadership (CEO, CTO, CPO, COO, CSO) at Infinite Lambda to formulate a clear strategy for combining data and cloud expertise into a holistic value proposition, strengthening the company’s market positioning;
  • Conduct regular research on industry trends, working with leadership to evolve strategies as appropriate to maintain competitiveness;
  • Deepen subject-matter knowledge in Infinite Lambda’s key industry verticals, ensuring a strong understanding of client needs and market dynamics.
SOUTH AMERICA EXPANSION
  • Partner with Infinite Lambda’s executive team to identify and establish delivery hubs in South America, supporting the company’s growth strategy in the region;
  • Actively participate in hiring efforts for the new hubs, and be physically present onsite to help set up team culture, fostering a positive and collaborative environment. This responsibility is timeboxed or milestone-based, such as a fixed duration of 6 months or until the first 15 hires are onboarded, as mutually agreed;
  • Ensure the expansion aligns with Infinite Lambda’s mission and values, contributing to long-term success in the region.
Additional Duties
  • Work with Infinite Lambda’s executive team to help steer the company’s overall strategy in a positive direction, providing insights from sales engineering perspectives.
  • Represent Infinite Lambda at external conferences and events, promoting the company’s brand, thought leadership, and expertise in data and cloud engineering.
Requirements
  • Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is required; an advanced degree is preferred;
  • Experience: A proven track record in sales engineering or technical sales, preferably within the data, cloud, or technology sectors, with significant leadership experience;
  • Technical expertise: experience in data engineering, analytics engineering and data scientist roles and related technologies, such as AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, dbt and machine learning frameworks is essential;
  • Data architecture: Stream processing and batch data warehouse processing, event-driven architecture, micro services, DataOps and MLOps practices;

  • Leadership and strategy: Experience in leading sales engineering teams or functions, with a strategic mindset to influence company direction and market expansion;
  • Collaboration: Strong ability to work effectively across different departments and levels, fostering collaboration with Product & Services, Customer Success, and Sales & Partnerships;
  • Market expansion: Experience in international markets or expanding into new regions is a plus, particularly knowledge of South American markets and business practices, which is desirable for this role.

description:
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to direct the technical approach and execution for a main internal project in the Fortnite ecosystem. They will be responsible for driving several engineering teams to be capable of meeting any technical challenge that may arise, curating the staffing levels across the various engineering specializations, providing critical technical insight and feedback, and supporting project planning from the engineering perspective. They will align project technical decisions to lead the project engineering team from the idea to a successful live online multiplayer game.

In this role, you will

Have the ability to align disparate audiences, both clarifying complex technical issues for non-engineering stakeholders and translating the needs of production and marketing for low-level developers

Be able to articulate challenges, risks, and trade-offs in a constructive way

Ensure feature request requirements are clear, consistent, and achievable

Regularly manage and mentor engineering leads and individual contributors

Communicate cross-discipline with Design, Art, UI, and Production to understand the goals and requirements of features to be implemented

Work with the engineering Leads to establish and refine our development roadmap

Challenge and align technical decisions across disciplines that lead the project to success

What we're looking for

A technical leader who excels at giving feedback and has demonstrated capabilities in facilitating team success

Experience in shipping AAA titles across multiple platforms

Experience with the unique challenges of creating and maintaining large-scale, live, online multiplayer games, with a focus on advanced networking, real-time physics, and dynamic, interoperating services

Advanced C++ skills and experience with scripting languages, low-level debugging, and optimization

Impeccable problem-solving and troubleshooting skills

Experience collaborating with and managing relationships with both internal teams and external partners

Deep expertise in the product lifecycle for games, such as generating detailed technical requirements, assembling capable teams, executing said requirements, and building robust support systems to manage them

Experience with Unreal Engine 5

Architecting and building solutions in multiple areas of expertise – Gameplay, Graphics, Audio, UI, Networking, and Physics

Passionate about personal development, taking advantage of opportunities to continuously improve

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

title: GERENTE SÊNIOR DE PRODUTO E OPERAÇÕES LOGÍSTICAS
description:
A AMARO é mais do que moda; somos a escolha assertiva da mulher brasileira para acompanhá-la em todos os seus melhores momentos. Com peças de qualidade, corte diferenciado, entrega super rápida e informação de moda relevante, temos clássicos que acompanham nossas clientes por toda a vida e lançamentos que trazem um novo olhar a cada estação.
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa estrategicamente orientada, com perfil analítico e experiência robusta em supply e sourcing, para assumir a posição de Gerente Sênior de Produto e Operações Logísticas na AMARO.
Essa posição será o elo central entre a criação e a execução: da definição dos volumes com o time de Estilo, passando pela produção com fornecedores até o recebimento dos produtos e sua entrega ao cliente final.
Embora inclua também a gestão logística (CD e transporte), o maior esforço e complexidade estarão no acompanhamento dos fluxos de produto e produção, exigindo familiaridade com o ciclo de desenvolvimento e entrega de coleções, múltiplos fornecedores e gestão de prioridades.
Seu dia a dia na Amaro:
Sourcing e Produto (foco principal):

  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de produto: desde o alinhamento de volumes com o time de Estilo até a chegada dos itens no CD.
  • Acompanhar e garantir os prazos de produção com fornecedores nacionais e internacionais, atuando com controle rigoroso de lead times e entregas.
  • Coordenar o recebimento físico e sistêmico dos produtos no CD, garantindo acuracidade, qualidade e conformidade.
  • Ser a principal interface com os times de Estilo e Produto, garantindo fluidez na comunicação e antecipação de riscos de produção.
  • Otimizar o calendário de desenvolvimento e recebimento, visando o abastecimento saudável da operação e o cumprimento de metas comerciais.
  • Liderar rotinas de alinhamento de status com fornecedores, estilo e planejamento.
Logística:
  • Gerir o Centro de Distribuição e parceiros logísticos (3PL), assegurando eficiência nas operações de armazenagem, expedição e transporte.
  • Monitorar KPIs logísticos como SLA de entrega, acuracidade de estoque, giro de recebimento e lead time de transporte.
  • Trabalhar com Tech e Operações para promover melhorias de sistema e automações no fluxo logístico.
O que estamos buscando?
  • Experiência sênior em cargos de liderança nas áreas de supply chain, sourcing, logística ou operações de produto.
  • Vivência com fornecedores de moda e cadeia têxtil (nacional e/ou internacional), com domínio de processos de desenvolvimento e produção.
  • Experiência em gestão de recebimento, controle de prazos, interface com estilo e acompanhamento de entrega de coleções.
  • Sólida experiência com gestão de operações logísticas, especialmente CD e transporte via operadores 3PL.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado(a) a dados, com domínio de KPIs operacionais e de supply.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para lidar com múltiplos stakeholders.
Diferenciais que Amamos:
  • Experiência em empresas de moda, e-commerce, D2C ou startups.
O que oferecemos?
  • Benefícios flexíveis que não se limitam a mercado e restaurante e podem ser usados em apps de delivery, mobilidade, cultura e todos os estabelecimentos que aceitam a bandeira Mastercard.
  • Assistência médica e odontológica (opcional).
  • Convênio com farmácias.
  • Vale transporte ou Estacionamento.
  • Petloves - Assistência Médica para seu Pet.
  • Auxílio creche.
  • Descontos exclusivos AMARO.com
  • Totalpass & Classpass: sua saúde física é importante!
  • Convênio com o Sesc.
  • Posher: serviços de beleza e bem estar.

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

Join us in shaping the future of Fortnite — one of the world’s most influential interactive platforms. We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to drive the development of foundational systems that support the Fortnite experience at scale — including player onboarding, progression, identity, lobbies, and purchasing. These systems form the connective tissue of the Fortnite ecosystem, powering player interaction, progression, and seamless transitions between experiences. This role is central to our goal of delivering consistent, high-quality user experiences across internal and third-party content — while enabling scale, flexibility, and innovation for the entire platform.

In this role, you will

O que é a nstech?

A nstech é a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo, construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é conectar e transformar a cadeia logística, oferecendo centenas de soluções integradas em um único lugar. Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina. Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 3500 nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade. Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação. title: Metal Spinner (Manual)
description:
Position is for our client: KIHM Metal Technologies, located in Brazil, Indiana.

Industry: Manufacturing

Essential Functions:

  1. Confer with engineering, supervisory, and manufacturing personnel to exchange technical information. Design fixtures, tooling, and experimental parts to meet specific engineering needs.
  2. Plan spinning processes by studying work orders, blueprints, engineering plans, materials, specifications, orthographic drawings, reference planes, surface locations, and machining parameters, interpreting geometric dimensions and tolerances (GD&T).
  3. Verify settings by measuring positions, first-run parts, and sample workpieces, ensuring adherence to blueprints or customer specifications.
  4. Observe and listen to operating machines or equipment to diagnose malfunctions and determine the need for adjustments or repairs.
  5. Measure, examine, and test completed units to detect defects and ensure conformance to specifications, using precision instruments such as micrometers.
  6. Clean and lubricate machines, tools, and equipment to remove grease, rust, stains, and foreign matter.
  7. Document actions by completing production and quality logs.
  8. Maintain equipment through preventive maintenance, following manufacturer's instructions, troubleshooting malfunctions, and calling for repairs.
  9. Adhere to safety procedures and regulations to maintain safe operations.
  10. Must be experienced in manual spin forming of metal components, preferably nickel-based alloys (Inconel, Hastelloy, etc.).
  11. Proficient in the use of measuring tools (micrometers, calipers, pi tapes, etc.).
  12. Capable of lifting 40 lbs.
  13. Stand for long periods.

Manual Spinning Duties:

  1. Set up and operate spinning lathe to shape articles from sheet or plate metal, using blueprints and knowledge of metal properties. Bolt specified spin chuck to headstock spindle and follower block to tailstock, using hand or power tools.
  2. Clamp metal disk to chuck by turning hand wheel to force follow block against disk.
  3. Secure steady rest fixture on cross-slide.
  4. Start the machine and apply spinning compound to the outside of the rotating disk.
  5. Position, hold, and move the long-handled compound lever tool against the disk, using the steady rest as a fulcrum, to form the disk over and into the shape of the spinning chuck.
  6. Adjust pressure on the disk based on metal type, shape, lathe speed, temperature, and thickness.
  7. Replace steady rest with bar tool attachment, and use the hand wheel to set the bar tool and cut off excess metal from the workpiece.

title: GPM - Group Product Manager
description:
Job description

Ter um currículo compatível com a vaga é importante. Mas, existem outros fatores igualmente relevantes na hora de escolher um novo Hero para compor nosso time: a compatibilidade pela cultura e o protagonismo com a nossa missão!

Cultura Hero é sobre ser alguém com atitude, curiosidade, respeito ao próximo e muita disposição para aprender e fazer acontecer. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, pois acreditamos que times diversos são mais fortes e inovadores. Estamos em um momento único, investindo para crescer rápido e sermos líderes no nosso setor. Aqui você vai encontrar muitas oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento, em um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico.

Quer fazer parte dessa construção e deixar o seu legado? Vem com a gente!

Sobre a Company Hero:

A Company Hero está revolucionando o mercado de trabalho independente no Brasil, sendo o aliado confiável dos profissionais PJ. Através de soluções práticas, empoderamos os PJs a crescer com liberdade e estabilidade. Nosso aplicativo pioneiro os orienta em cada etapa da jornada, transformando desafios em oportunidades.

Aqui, acreditamos no poder do trabalho independente e estamos prontos para apoiar cada herói a alcançar seu potencial máximo, transformando o medo da instabilidade em segurança!

Sobre nosso momento:

A Hero tem mais de 40 mil clientes com um faturamento sólido que cresce bem todos os meses.

Neste momento estamos ampliando a nossa proposta de valor, incluindo seguros e outros serviços que possam trazer tranquilidade para quem trabalha neste formato.

Por isso passamos recentemente por umarevolução de Produto e Tecnologia na empresa, migrando toda nossa operação para um aplicativo, o PJ Hero . Ao mesmo tempo que evoluímos nossa intra, infra e dados para suportar esta nova fase.

O animador de passar por esse processo é que estamos desenvolvendo as bases do zero e conectando tudo para que o produto promova os resultados esperados pelo negócio: tenha tração, uso recorrente e cross sell.

Sobre o Desafio:

Nesta posição, você será responsável por liderar a equipe de PMs e PDs com o objetivo de implementar a visão de produto da empresa, reportando diretamente ao Diretor.

Atualmente, temos uma squad por iniciativa de produto, além da iniciativa de IA, que está em formação. Cada uma dessas frentes está em um estágio diferente do ciclo de vida de produto.

Seu desafio será gerar coesão entre elas, acelerar o desenvolvimento dos PMs e PDs e alavancar os resultados das squads. Nesse contexto, você atuará de forma próxima aos times, entrando nos detalhes e influenciando diretamente o produto por meio dos rituais com o time. Além disso, terá um papel importante na construção e aplicação de ferramentas de gestão de carreira. O crescimento do seu time será um dos seus principais objetivos.

Além da atuação direta com seus liderados, você também terá um papel relevante nos projetos estratégicos em andamento, junto aos outros líderes de tecnologia e dados. Esse grupo é responsável pela definição estratégica de tecnologia da empresa, e você será a principal voz de produto nesse contexto.

Temos uma visão clara de negócio, alinhada à visão de produto. Mas, com sua experiência e aprendizados do dia a dia, você irá colaborar diretamente na definição e nos ajustes dessa estratégia e roadmap.

Apesar de a Hero já contar com 40.000 clientes e um sólido faturamento, mantemos a agilidade de uma startup em estágio inicial. Estamos em plena expansão — um cenário muito familiar para quem já foi fundador de uma startup ou esteve entre os primeiros colaboradores, mas com mais recursos

O produto é novo e temos que colocar o MVP no ar, do zero. Em paralelo, temos outros produtos ganhando tração e que precisam ser integrados à nossa estrutura — além de um que já gera milhares de vendas por mês e requer otimização da jornada.

Você vai se dar bem se curtir um ambiente dinâmico, aprender fazendo e tiver versatilidade para lidar com diferentes estágios de produto ao mesmo tempo. Mas vai se dar bem, principalmente, se já tiver vivido tudo isso antes.

Essa vaga é para quem já viveu esse cenário — e quer viver de novo, agora com mais estrutura, time e potencial para fazer a diferença.


Main responsibilities

  • Compreender a fundo o negócio da empresa e as suas focus metrics, contribuir para a formulação de estratégias dos produto junto com a equipe;
  • Compreender profundamente o usuário e seus desafios da experiência, no produto e fora dele. Atuar na busca de soluções;
  • Desenvolvimento de pessoas deve ser um dos seus temas favoritos. Aprender, implementar e aprimorar ferramentas de desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecer detalhadamente o perfil e competências dos liderados. Planejar e trabalhar em conjunto para seu crescimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Ter rituais para analisar métricas e definir plano de ação com as equipes;
  • Manter a comunicação e o alinhamento com as lideranças das outras áreas, gerando combinado e facilitando o trabalho da equipe;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das iniciativas da equipe de perto, tendo o roadmap como referência. Retirar impedimentos e fazer negociações sempre quando necessário;
  • Ser um embaixador e referência em gestão de produtos;
  • Promover a cultura de produtos na empresa e na equipe, incorporando boas práticas, talks, frameworks e metodologias que orientem a criação de produtos de valor;
  • Acompanhar de perto artigos, concorrentes e benchmarks, para enriquecer as discussões e trazer novas oportunidades de gerar crescimento e/ou melhorar a experiência dos clientes;
  • Propor e facilitar discussões entre stakeholders para avançar na definição e de estratégias ou decisões importantes para a o negócio;
  • Trabalhar com o Diretor nos follow ups e fora deles para colaborar em iniciativas e manter todos atualizados.

Requirements and skills

  • Ter sido fundador de uma startup ou ter estado entre os primeiros funcionários;
  • Atuado pelo menos 2 ano em startup, não importa o resultado dela;
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência em gerenciamento de produtos com histórico de ter feito lançamentos e busca de PMF;
  • Ampla vivência na gestão e monitoramento de cadeias de valor, com exemplos concretos de resultados alcançados nas empresas em que trabalhou;
  • Ter vivências que comprovem forte capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Ter vivência e conhecimento técnico suficiente para conduzir uma squad especialista, como dados e meios de pagamento;
  • Excelente capacidade analíticas orientada a problema, com habilidade de elaborar hipóteses e testes lógicos para elas;
  • Escuta ativa e habilidade de capturar a necessidade do cliente;
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e falada, com capacidade de síntese e simplificação para adapta-la de acordo com a situação;
  • Adorar trabalhar em equipe, em ambientes não hierárquicos;
  • Imprescindível disponibilidade para trabalhar no Híbrido 2x/semana em São Paulo

Você vai se dar bem se:

  • Gostar de estar em um ambiente acelerado;
  • Gostar de trabalhar em equipe e fazer parte de um time que trabalha sério mas de forma leve e divertida;
  • For muito organizado e orientado ao resultado/impacto;
  • Sempre investir em comunicar bem, usando recursos visuais sempre que for facilitar a compreensão - fazer o complexo se tornar simples;
  • Tiver poder de síntese e pensamento lógico;
  • Estiver buscando um desafio para construir um case;
  • Gostar de entender tecnicamente como as soluções funcionam.

Additional information

  • Envio de equipamentos;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • ???? Benefício Saúde;
  • Benefício Odontológico;
  • ️Auxílio Contabilidade para PJs - ME;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Proteção Inicial;
  • Day Off no mês do seu aniversário;
  • WellHub;
  • Pausa Baby Hero:dias para ficar com seu bebê após o nascimento dele;
  • Pausa para casamento;
  • Reembolso creche;
  • Escritório Virtual Hero;
  • Ótimo ambiente de trabalho com espaço de lazer, sala de jogos e muita descontração!

  • Strong communications and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to multitask and meet deadlines in a timely manner

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Make your mark in Marketing & Communications

How you will create an impact

Reporting to the Head Marketing and Communications, Latin America and Caribbean, and to the GM for Brazil, this role has accountability of marketing and communications strategy, internal communications, content marketing, events, media relations and sales enablement in support of AIG Brazil.

The role will be responsible for establishing processes, best practices, and strategic business marketing and communications plans in support of AIG Brazil – including distribution engagement programs targeted to clients, brokers and partners; our events program, product/solutions marketing, differentiated knowledge leadership, attributable content marketing, and alignment with distribution to deliver AIG’s full capabilities to the market. This role is also responsible for developing and implementing strategic communications plans, encompassing external, internal and leadership communications, media relations and knowledge leadership to AIG’s stakeholders.

  • Develop best practices for demand-driven event marketing, knowledge leadership, content marketing and social media campaigns that facilitate sales growth;
  • Closely partner with Brazil business and functional leaders to promote and sustain a consistent AIG brand identity across businesses;

  • Oversight and governance of external vendor engagement

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Significant experience in marketing and communications strategy development, execution and team leadership
  • Thorough knowledge of marketing and communications principles, product/service management, sales enablement and business development
  • Demonstrated ability to manage media relations, crisis management and corporate social responsibility efforts

  • Significant prior experience managing complex projects across geographies, businesses, products and segments;

  • Proven ability to lead and develop teams, driving high levels of performance and build a pipeline of talent within the function;
  • Experience within the Insurance, broader Financial Services or regulated sectors preferred;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, preferably also Spanish

That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. title: Pessoa Analista de Compras Sênior
description:
Profissional responsável por gerenciar e conduzir processos estratégicos e operacionais de compras, assegurando a otimização de custos, qualidade dos produtos e serviços adquiridos e a eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos. Atua estrategicamente na negociação, homologação e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, buscando inovação, mitigação de riscos e excelência operacional.

Atuação está diretamente ligada ao cumprimento de normas, políticas internas e compliance, garantindo que as aquisições sejam feitas de forma sustentável e alinhada aos objetivos da empresa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar processos de compras, incluindo a elaboração de RFI (Request for Information), RFQ (Request for Quotation) e RFP (Request for Proposal) para garantir competitividade e transparência.
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de compras, desde a identificação da necessidade até a entrega e pagamento, garantindo que os processos sigam as diretrizes da empresa.
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos, assegurando qualidade, confiabilidade e competitividade.
  • Realizar visitas técnicas e auditorias a fornecedores, garantindo conformidade com os padrões estabelecidos.
  • Negociar cláusulas contratuais e elaborar contratos comerciais, assegurando cumprimento de prazos, custos e qualidade dos produtos e serviços.
  • Implementar práticas de Gestão de Relacionamento com Fornecedores (SRM), garantindo relacionamento saudável e de longo prazo com fornecedores.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, oscilações de preços e riscos econômicos (como variação cambial, custo de matérias-primas e inflação).
  • Implementar estratégias para redução de custos e maximização de eficiência operacional, aplicando conceitos como TCO (Custo total por propriedade) e should cost analysis (Custo x Benefício).
  • Assegurar a conformidade dos processos de compras com as normas fiscais, tributárias e auditorias aplicáveis.
  • Utilizar dashboards e ferramentas analíticas (Power BI, Excel avançado, Tableau) para suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Aplicar metodologias Lean e Six Sigma para redução de desperdícios e melhoria contínua dos processos de suprimentos.
  • Monitorar os níveis de estoque e consumo, propondo estratégias de compras just-in-time (JIT) para redução de custos e otimização de armazenagem.
  • Planejar e gerenciar operações de importação e desembaraço aduaneiro, garantindo conformidade regulatória e eficiência no tempo de entrega.
  • Analisar o impacto logístico das aquisições, incluindo fretes, armazenagem e modais de transporte.
  • Participar ativamente do planejamento orçamentário da área de compras, garantindo alinhamento financeiro e previsibilidade.
  • Promover inovação na cadeia de suprimentos, buscando novas tecnologias e fornecedores que agreguem valor ao negócio.
  • Demais atividades inerentes da função.

Job Summary

What is a Junior Consultant at Red Hat?
As part of the customer delivery team, a Junior Consultant at Red Hat is a technical person who supports the on-site delivery, implementation and adoption of Red Hat technology. These projects span various industries as we partner with customers to build enterprise IT solutions based on Red Hat platforms that are the trusted, consistent, and comprehensive foundation for any enterprise.

Job Summary
You may be thinking -- What is a Junior Consultant at Red Hat?
As part of the customer delivery team, a Junior Consultant at Red Hat is a technical person who supports the on-site delivery, implementation and adoption of Red Hat technology. These projects span various industries as we partner with customers to build enterprise IT solutions based on Red Hat platforms that are the trusted, consistent, and comprehensive foundation for any enterprise.
In other words, a Junior Consultant at Red Hat can be you…
So, are you ready to launch your technical career with Red Hat? If so, we are looking for passionate individuals early in their technical career to help us unlock the world’s potential.
What You Will Do
During your first year as a Junior Consultant, you will engage in a cohort-based program. Through this experience, you will:

  • Learn all about Red Hat and how we support our customers to address their technical developmental and strategic business challenges with our portfolio and services
  • Build a strong support network of your Peers, Manager, Mentor and other Red Hatters within and outside of your customer projects
  • Develop technical skills in the Red Hat portfolio that span Cloud, Automation and AI solutions by completing training programs and attaining industry-recognized certifications
  • Apply your technical skills as you engage in meaningful customer projects, experiences and job shadowing opportunities
  • Enhance your professional capabilities through real-world experiences working directly with customers and participating in skill development opportunities
  • Focus on your personal and professional development as you grow your career at Red Hat
What You Will Bring
  • Passion and curiosity for open source technology and desire to build a career within the Tech industry
  • Strong technical skills in computer science, IT, AI, or related fields gained through university programs, upskilling bootcamps, certificate programs, military experience, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience applying technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills in an Enterprise IT-related project. Direct experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, and related technologies is preferred.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites for project work and to local Red Hat offices to engage other Red Hat associates
  • Effective communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with internal teams and external customers
  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken Portuguese
About Red Hat
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.
